Interface WeatherStationImplementationI

  • All Superinterfaces:
    WeatherStationConfigurationI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    WeatherStation

    public interface WeatherStationImplementationI
extends WeatherStationConfigurationI
    The interface WeatherStationImplementationI declares the signatures of methods that a weather station component must implement.

    Description

    This interface proposes as methods the same signatures as in the component interface WeatherStationCI.

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant
